functions.name: commit_statuses
functions.description: Canonical commit status events keyed by repository and status ID. History lists every event for a ref; latest retrieves only the current event for each context across every combined-status page. Latest retrieval resolves the ref through a retained aggregate parent, preserving empty commits. Timestamp strings from history remain created_at_raw/updated_at_raw VARCHAR; latest typed date-time values populate created_at/updated_at only. Fields absent from a selected API schema remain NULL, including creator in latest and required in history. No timestamp parsing or fabricated creators are applied.

functions.name: push_bypass_requests
functions.description: Push-rule bypass requests identified globally by request ID, with repository-local request numbers for lookup. Requester and delegated-reviewer roles remain separate; all typed violation summaries and responses are retained. The pinned GET operations are available in the ghec product contract. Optional IDs are explicitly required at emission; absent nested metadata remains unknown. Organization retrieval retains requests with missing repository evidence; reported repository identity remains nullable.
